title: Discrete lifts finally index the opposite localization Kan extension
statement: Let P be a property of morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], containing identities and closed under composition, with right cancellation: if P(f) and P(a followed by f), then P(a). For a scheme B, write C_P(B) for schemes T with a structure morphism T -> B satisfying P, with all B-morphisms as arrows. Let f : Y -> X satisfy P and let W be an object of C_P(X). Composition with f defines L : C_P(Y) -> C_P(X). Then there exist a small type I and a final functor s from the discrete category on I to the costructured-arrow category (L^op down W^op), such that every structure arrow L^op(s(i).left) -> W^op is an isomorphism. One may take I to be the type of X-morphisms W -> Y. The statement covers arbitrary f satisfying P, without a monomorphism assumption, and also the empty type of lifts.

proof.text: Define I as the subtype of arrows alpha : W.left -> Y with alpha followed by f equal to W.hom. Cancellation for P makes alpha an object W_alpha of C_P(Y). The identity of W.left gives an isomorphism W -> L(W_alpha). Its opposite defines a comma object s(alpha); these objects define the functor s from the discrete category I.

Every comma object c is an object T of C_P(Y) with an X-arrow a : W -> L(T), and hence induces the lift a.left followed by T.hom. This induced lift is unchanged under comma morphisms. For a fixed lift alpha, a comma morphism c -> s(alpha) exists exactly when c induces alpha: its arrow in C_P(Y), after unop, must be a.left. The comma equation forces this arrow uniquely, and the equality of induced lifts is precisely the condition that it is over Y. Thus sending c to its induced lift is left adjoint to s.

A right adjoint is final, so s is final. Each s(alpha) has invertible structure arrow because its underlying arrow is the identity of W.left. If I is empty, the construction still works: there are no comma objects, since each would induce a lift. This is exactly the existing source proof, whose axiom check contains only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
